messages.text: I think we should delay the analytics dashboard beta until role-based access is complete. Two design partners said they cannot test with real data if every admin can see every workspace.
Agreed. Without role-based access, the dashboard could expose team-level metrics to the wrong people. Engineering needs about three more weeks.
I'm worried a delay could weaken the enterprise demo pipeline, but assuming the design partners will wait, this is the safer call. Let's revisit on 2026-10-09.
Final decision: delay the analytics dashboard beta until role-based access is complete and revisit on 2026-10-09.
Proposal: use S3 pre-signed URLs for customer data exports because routing large files through the app server is causing timeout risk.
I agree. The tradeoff is a little more IAM complexity, but export reliability is the bigger risk.
If download links become hard to audit later, we can revisit the design after the beta.
Approved, let's move forward with S3 pre-signed URLs for customer data exports.
